description: This is a Java test class for the OrderEntry functionality within the OpenMRS project. It contains end-to-end tests for placing, discontinuing, revising, voiding, and querying orders, specifically testing order entry operations such as drug orders and test orders, as well as handling of retrospective data entry.

classes.name: OrderEntryIntegrationTest
classes.description: Test class for end-to-end order entry operations in OpenMRS, including placing, discontinuing, revising, voiding, and querying orders.

methods.name: shouldGetTheActiveOrdersForAPatient
methods.description: Test retrieval of active orders for a specific patient.

methods.name: shouldGetTheActiveDrugOrdersForAPatient
methods.description: Test retrieval of active drug orders for a patient.

methods.name: shouldPlaceADrugOrder
methods.description: Test placement of a new drug order, verifying it appears in active orders.

methods.name: shouldPlaceATestOrder
methods.description: Test placement of a new test order, verifying it appears in active orders.

methods.name: shouldDiscontinueAnActiveOrder
methods.description: Test discontuining orders using various methods and verify their deactivation.

methods.name: shouldReviseAnOrder
methods.description: Test revising an existing order and ensure only the revised order remains active.

methods.name: shouldVoidAnOrderAndFlushSuccessfully
methods.description: Test voiding an order and verify session flushing.

methods.name: shouldUnvoidAnOrderAndFlushSuccessfully
methods.description: Test unvoiding a previously voided order.

methods.name: shouldDiscontinueAnActiveOrderAndFlushSuccessfully
methods.description: Test discontuining an order with flush after session changes.

methods.name: shouldReviseAnOrderAndFlushSuccessfully
methods.description: Test revising an order with flush after session changes.

methods.name: shouldFailIfAnEditedOrderIsFlushed
methods.description: Ensure editing and flushing an order with invalid field modification throws an exception.

methods.name: shouldNotReturnAProxyForPreviousOrder
methods.description: Verify that previous orders are returned as actual objects, not proxies, ensuring correct subclass instances.

methods.name: shouldAllowEditingADiscontinuationOrder
methods.description: Test editing and saving of a discontinuation order and verify correct previous order linkage.

methods.name: shouldAllowRetrospectiveDataEntryOfOrders
methods.description: Test creating orders with retrospective dates, including discontinuation.

methods.name: shouldAllowRevisionOfOrdersInRetrospectiveDataEntry
methods.description: Test revising orders created retrospectively and verify date adjustments.
